PASS if the report contains a finding that matches all of:

- its severity is Blocking
- its substance: The 0.50 Jackson 2 module types-jackson is added; every persistence serializer throws at startup. The fix (types-jackson → types-jackson3) is mechanical. Reported as ONE row: stack-lint's ESS-S3.1 on the same dependency is the same defect and is named on that row, not listed again.
